args.message: Fix round_money to use banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN) per FIN-212

args.body:
## Summary
`round_money` in `src/money.py` used `ROUND_HALF_UP`, contradicting its own docstring and FIN-212, which requires banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN). The nightly build failed because `tests/test_money.py` asserts half-even behavior (e.g., `Decimal("2.665")` must round to `2.66`, not `2.67`).

## Changes
- `src/money.py`: switch rounding mode to `ROUND_HALF_EVEN`.

## Testing
- CI run `ci-0001` on `08d3cd5986`: passed (includes `test_half_even`).
